items.name: Furkan Berber
items.quote:
Kostas has very unique system to train protection dogs. His system builds top notch protection dogs who can neutralize any threats. He hand picks dogs from his own breedings and then raises them for couple years until their their training is complete. This creates much better results compared to companies who mass produce from imported dogs. If you need a real protection dog hit him up, he will raise the dog you need!

His communication skills are also top notch so he can raise a dog for your needs.

items.name: Caroline
items.quote:
I bought a Belgian Malinois from Kostas several years ago, and I can confidently say it was one of the best decisions I’ve ever made. From the very beginning, Kostas was there every step of the way—always available to answer my questions, offer guidance, and help me navigate life with my new dog. His deep knowledge, professionalism, and genuine passion for his dogs set him apart.

It’s rare to find someone who truly cares about both their dogs and their customers the way Kostas does. Even years later, I know I can still reach out to him if I ever need advice. The quality and temperament of my Malinois exceeded all my expectations, and when the time comes to add another dog to my family, there’s no doubt in my mind—I’ll be going straight to Kostas.

If you’re looking for an exceptional dog and an even better person to work with, look no further. I highly recommend Kostas to anyone searching for a loyal, well-bred companion

items.name: Melissa Moon
items.quote:
Protection Dogs GR and Kostas are very knowledgeable and experienced in both determining the potential of canines and training the canines that qualify for their protection dog program. Kostas is very discerning and openly shares the rationale behind his determinations. He is a pleasure to work with as he is very honest and patient. I had a copious amount of questions (like really - a LOT)  and he answered them all. 

His dogs are raised and trained with his family, and you can see that this is truly his passion.

Thank you so so much , i definitely getting a male soon to make them a couple again thank you so much .
